name: Plate CVIII: AUM, the Pranava
description: The sacred syllable from which the Vedas say the worlds were sounded into being, enthroned on the lotus and ringed by the Gayatri and a mala of one hundred and eight beads. Struck in Saffron Night: saffron and the violet of the night before the first sound. One of the Seven Hierophants: a single plate, composed by hand, of which there is no other.
